user.title: Connect brain_zero
user.description: Connect through Home Assistant's MQTT broker. The controller ID is shown in brain_zero under Settings → Connectivity → MQTT. The web address is used for the controller link.

error.cannot_connect: No response from this controller through the Home Assistant MQTT broker. Check that brain_zero is connected and has MQTT control firmware.

init.title: Home Assistant charging and battery input
init.description: Keep plans in Home Assistant and forward authenticated battery measurements. These options do not put credentials in firmware. Leave a pairing key blank to keep its current value.

data.charging_adapter: Manage charging plans in Home Assistant

error.invalid_charging_options: Use host names or IPv4 addresses and matching 32–128 character pairing keys.
